Earlier grep for "maven.pkg.github" only found .github/dependabot.yml. Let me check that, and also search for where GITHUB_TOKEN is read by gradle (the build logic jar might read it). The build logic logic-1.0.56.jar could contain the repository configuration that uses GITHUB_TOKEN. Let me download the jar and inspect.

Actually, this is the critical path. Let me download the logic jar and look for maven repository config referencing GITHUB_TOKEN.
